rooms.name: Stable
rooms.desc: A stable: a horse, birds squawking, a ladder to a loft, sliding doors chained shut.
rooms.dm: Drusilla; the small east door opens to the storage room; the loft is the ravens'.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: A cluttered kitchen round a pine worktable, two lanterns above it.
rooms.dm: The secret door at the west end of the south wall leads up to the hidden hall.

rooms.name: Wine Storage
rooms.desc: Empty wine barrels stacked two high by the kitchen door.

rooms.name: Storage
rooms.desc: A cramped space under the stair with a chest.

rooms.name: Taproom
rooms.desc: A packed taproom under a balcony: lanterns in dull orange, wolf heads on plaques, a bar along the west wall, shutters and crossbars on every window.
rooms.dm: Danika tends bar; Urwin cooks; Rictavio, the wolf hunters, Ismark's friends. Everything bars from within.

rooms.name: Outside Staircase
rooms.desc: A wooden stair up the outer wall to the guest quarters.
rooms.dm: The door at the top bars from inside.

rooms.name: Porch
rooms.desc: The inn's porch and double doors.

rooms.name: Well
rooms.desc: A well in the inn yard.

objects.label: A secret door at the west end of the kitchen's south wall: a wooden stair up to the hidden hall
Wolf heads mounted on plaques along the walls
Danika at the bar, Urwin in the kitchen; Rictavio holds court by the fire; the wolf hunters Szoldar and Yevgeni at the corner table. Doors and shutters bar from within.
Twelve empty barrels piled two high; the double doors bar from within.
A dozen horseshoes, a mallet and nails in an unlocked chest
Drusilla, Rictavio's horse
Ravens roosting in the rafters (four swarms if roused)

rooms.name: Ravens' Loft
rooms.desc: A loft of hay and pitchforks under dirty windows, ravens everywhere.
rooms.dm: A locked chest under the hay; the ravens attack as four swarms if it is touched. Secret door to the master bedroom.

rooms.name: Secret Stairs and Hall
rooms.desc: A short panelled hall with a window, a stair down at its north end.
rooms.dm: Secret doors at both ends; Rictavio has heard the boys use it.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A canopied bed in red silk between end tables; a tapestry of a mountain valley.
rooms.dm: Secret door to the loft at the west end of the south wall; hidden trapdoor to the attic.

rooms.name: Boys' Bedroom
rooms.desc: Two small beds with a painted toy box between them.
rooms.dm: Blinsky toys in the box; a hidden trapdoor in the 8-ft ceiling to the attic.

rooms.name: Great Balcony
rooms.desc: A balcony the length of the taproom, railings carved with ravens, the rafters in lantern light.
rooms.dm: 15 ft above the taproom; secret door at the south end of the west wall.

rooms.name: Guest Balcony
rooms.desc: A twenty-foot balcony overlooking the bar.

rooms.name: Outside Staircase (head)
rooms.desc: The head of the outside stair.

rooms.name: Guest Rooms
rooms.desc: Two cosy beds heaped with wolf furs, footlockers, a lamp between them, two black wardrobes.
rooms.dm: Locks from inside; each guest gets a key.

rooms.name: Guest Rooms (south)
rooms.desc: Two cosy beds heaped with wolf furs, footlockers, a lamp between them, two black wardrobes.
rooms.dm: Locks from inside; each guest gets a key.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: Four plain beds with straw mattresses along the north wall, a table and chairs in the corner, a bright oil lamp.

rooms.name: Private Guest Room
rooms.desc: A small room: a bed heaped with furs, a footlocker, a tall wardrobe, a writing desk.
rooms.dm: Rictavio's room, locked; the journal names Drusilla and his oddities. The lock is picked in full view of the taproom.

objects.label: A secret door between the loft and the master bedroom (light shows through the cracks)
Secret door from the hidden hall into the boys' room
Secret door at the south end of the great balcony's west wall into the hidden hall
A tapestry of a mountain valley hangs across from the bed
A hidden trapdoor in the 8-ft ceiling opens into the secret attic
A hidden trapdoor in the ceiling opens into the secret attic
Blinsky toys in the box: a puppet theatre, a toy Vistani wagon, clown masks, a scarecrow top, a stuffed bat on strings.
A balcony the length of the taproom, 15 ft above its floor, its railing carved with ravens.
Rictavio's journal in the desk: his horse Drusilla, his 'oddities', nothing of Van Richten by name
Rictavio (Rudolph van Richten) when he is in; 40% between noon and dusk
A locked chest under the hay: 140 ep, 70 pp, two elixirs of health, three potions of healing, a grey bag of tricks
The ravens of the loft: four swarms if the chest is touched

rooms.name: Secret Attic
rooms.desc: A low attic of straw nests, a strongbox against the north wall, a small square hole to the sky.
rooms.dm: The wereravens' roost. Two trapdoors down to the bedrooms. Urwin keeps the strongbox key.

objects.label: A locked iron strongbox against the north wall (Urwin has the key): the Keepers' letters and 300 gp
A small square opening in the south wall: raven-sized
Ten by thirty-five feet, the ceiling slanting from 8 ft to 5 ft westward; the Martikovs sleep here as ravens.
